# Pinterest India

> > Visual discovery platform featuring creative DIY projects, fashion inspiration, anime art, craft tutorials, and seasonal celebration ideas primarily in Russian and English languages.

Pinterest India (in.pinterest.com) serves as a localized version of Pinterest, showcasing diverse content ranging from handmade gift tutorials (like Kinder chocolate bouquets) to anime character drawings (Gojo Satoru, Mikey), fashion styling guides, crochet patterns, and holiday greeting cards. The platform aggregates pins from creators and sources including YouTube tutorials and Яндекс Дзен articles.

## Key Topics

- DIY crafts and handmade gifts
- Kinder chocolate bouquet tutorials
- Anime character drawings (Gojo Satoru, Getou Suguru, Mikey)
- Tokyo Revengers and Bleach fanart
- Fashion outfit styling and street style
- Crochet patterns and tablecloth schemes
- Russian greeting cards and celebrations
- Medical Worker Day and healthcare humor
- Edible gift arrangements
- YouTube craft tutorials
- Яндекс Дзен content
- Black and white anime illustrations
- Winter fashion and camel color styling
- Candy bouquet crafts
- Nurses Day celebrations

## DIY Crafts & Gift Tutorials

- [БУКЕТ ИЗ ШОКОЛАДОК и КИНДЕРОВ / Как сделать букет из шоколадок своими руками](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/200269514668406985/): DIY Kinder chocolate bouquet tutorial pin with YouTube video link showing step-by-step instructions for creating handmade edible gift arrangements

## Anime Art & Character Illustrations

- [Чб Аниме Рисунки](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/чб-аниме-рисунки/912463076083/): Black and white anime drawings collection featuring popular characters like Gojo Satoru, Mikey from Tokyo Revengers, and other manga-inspired artwork

## Fashion & Style Inspiration

- [С чем носить ореховый: 12 стильных идей для утонченных натур](https://in.pinterest.com/pin/682999099726750444/): Hazelnut/camel color outfit styling ideas for winter fashion featuring casual outfits and street style combinations for sophisticated tastes

## Crochet & Handcraft Patterns

- [Круглая Скатерть Крючком Схемы](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/круглая-скатерть-крючком-схемы/899573332233/): Round crochet tablecloth patterns and schemes idea collection with detailed diagrams for handmade home decor projects

## Holiday & Celebration Ideas

- [С Днем Медицинского Работника Прикольные](https://in.pinterest.com/ideas/с-днем-медицинского-работника-прикольные/939740401632/): Medical Worker Day greeting cards idea collection featuring humorous and celebratory designs for healthcare professionals, nurses, and doctors
